Arvada Police Investigating Shooting and Armed Robbery

Arvada, CO — October 11, 2025 — 8:41 p.m.
Arvada Police Officers responded to a second shooting in the area of W. 54th Avenue and Harlan Street. 
Upon arrival, officers from the Arvada Police Department and the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office determined the incident was connected to an armed robbery and carjacking in which the victim had been shot multiple times. The victim was transported to a local hospital; their condition is currently unknown.

The two shootings from this evening are not related. These are two separate incidents.

Officers from the Colorado State Patrol, Wheat Ridge Police Department, and Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office assisted in locating the stolen vehicle. An Arvada FLOCK safety camera system identified the car, and officers pursued the suspects. The pursuit was brought to a safe conclusion using a tactical pursuit intervention technique. The suspects attempted to flee on foot but were quickly taken into custody.

Traffic Advisory:
Westbound I-70 at Wadsworth Boulevard is reduced to two lanes, and the westbound on-ramps from Wadsworth are currently closed. The estimated reopening time is approximately 90 minutes from this release.

This remains a very active investigation, and no further details will be released at this time.

@CSP_News @jeffcosheriffco @ArvadaFire @WheatRidgePD
